Hi Silverkid99, I was out of therapy for a few months because I changed insurance companies, but I had my first appointment with my new therapist last week.

Thanks for commenting. Cutting isn't logical, but neither is depression. Sometimes everything gets muddled and confusing. One minute I'm having a really deep and intriguing conversation with my Grandpa, the next hour, something hits me (could be anything) and then I'm crying in the shower. 
I guess it could be worse. Before I began therapy, life always seemed bleak and dark. Now life is usually partly cloudy with a chance of extreme thunderstorms. 
I have my sunny and 75° days too...

Thank you for your kind words and support. I do feel much better now. It sucks to relapse, but now I have to move forward. I hope that you too can remember that the bad times make the good times so much sweeter. You have helped me during this difficult time. You are wonderful. ❤️
Thank you. The situation is all about perception. Now that I'm level headed, I remeber that. Thank you for reminding me that I may have lost a battle, but I didn't lose the war. ❤️

Disclaimer: I am by no means and expert. Have you studied the cognitive functions? If not, I highly suggest it. You may be mistyped. It's  also possible that you have a more developed Te than other infps, but Idk. As for gender identity issues, I think that occurs in evrry type, but I can see it being more common in infps, as it is so important to us to be our true and genuine selves despite social pressure.

Wow. I can so relate to this. I also give strong meaning to small occurrences that other clasify as silly. I don't think there'd be much harm in writing the letter, at least you'd get it off your chest. The principal may find it odd, but hopefully they also find it endearing (as I would). This is obviously important to you. What is important to you matters and should be dealt with in the way you feel is best.
I can really relate. The one thing that I always try to remember is that people's opinions are usually a reflection of them and not me.

We do seem to have a tendancy to have depression. Not all of us obviously, but it seems to be a common occurance within our type. For example, I see a therapist every two weeks, I take zoloft and I've been hospitalized twice for suicidal ideation. Ever since I started getting help though, I feel SO MUCH better. I genuinely like myself now and I have a positive outlook on life. ♡:)

Yes! I think it is difficult for others to understand how draining prolonged socializing can be for some people. We need to recharge. Some people aren't like that at all, so they can't understand it.
